overview_description.description: Areeb Capital is a financial services group that specializes in the creation and execution of innovative investment offerings. The company targets High-Net-Worth Individuals, Family Companies, Family Offices, Corporations, and Financial Sponsors. In addition to this, Areeb Capital also operates as a Private Equity and Real Estate asset management company. The company is known for its commitment to privacy and has a policy in place to protect the personal data of those who visit its website.
